assistant_text.text: Hi Avery! I'm the Smalltalk Assistant. In the next few minutes I'll show you two agents talking to each other, then a small mission running, and then I'll ask what you'd like to do. I run on your own account, so this uses its usage. You can say "skip" whenever you like.
Two agents just sent each other messages, and either of them can wake the other. You saw both sides.
A notice now sits above the message input. You can read it and dismiss it. What do you want to accomplish in Smalltalk today?
You have been quiet, so I will leave it here. I am available whenever you want to start.
